scopeIntroduction: Three displays: one 15.6-inch, one 10-inch and one 4-inch. Essential smart-home scope and separately priced network. Installation includes 36 hours delivered: 15 complimentary and 21 billed.

items.name: SmartHome Server package (controller with Zigbee/Thread radio)
Smart light switch (physical button, smart function)
Installation, configuration and programming (hours; 36 delivered, 15 complimentary)
UniFi U7 Lite Wi-Fi 7 ceiling access point (U7-Lite)

dashboards.label: Wall displays
items: 1 area dashboard and 1 scene-control dashboard on the 4" display.

voiceControl: Hosted Google Assistant voice control. Chinese and English room/device naming was reported working in testing; each wall tablet and phone must be configured and verified individually at handover. Voice depends on each member’s Google account and device Google services; internet is required and offline voice is not guaranteed.
integrations: Client network and separate IoT network setup.

automations.label: 6 automations, agreed at project kickoff
items: Away scene: lights turn on and off at random when no one is home.

terms: The Essential smart-home package includes 36 hours of installation and setup: 15 hours complimentary and 21 hours billed. Work beyond 36 hours is charged separately at $180.00 per hour.
Switch and in-wall display fitting requires a licensed electrician. Electrical work and new data cabling to display positions are not included and are quoted separately after a site visit.
Optional tablet and sauna add-ons are fixed prices outside the 36 hours. If extra time is needed, approval is obtained before any extra charge.
Best-effort integrations depend on device and manufacturer support for Home Assistant. Unreliable integration is not charged as extra hours.
Home Assistant remote access and cloud backup use a Nabu Casa subscription paid directly by the client.
Voice control uses the client’s own Google accounts and requires internet; local/offline voice is not guaranteed.
Network is priced separately and may be accepted on its own.
Prices are valid for 30 days from issue. Hardware prices may change if supplier prices change before order.
Hyper-care is provided for 60 days and covers support and bug fixes within agreed scope for the system as delivered; it excludes new features.

Hardware warranty is two years for hardware supplied by us. Client-supplied tablet is excluded from hardware warranty; our configuration work is covered by 60-day hyper-care. Correcting a defect in our own work is never chargeable; out-of-scope work requires a separate quote. Nothing limits rights under Australian Consumer Law.
hyperCare: 60 days of support and bug fixes within agreed scope for the system as delivered; new features are excluded.
warranty: Two years for hardware supplied by us. Client-supplied tablet is excluded from hardware warranty; configuration work remains covered by 60-day hyper-care.

optionalAddons.title: Repurpose existing wall tablet
details: AirTouch installed an Android wall tablet; subject to on-site checks of Android version, Google services and recovery after power loss.
The tablet must restart without re-locking to the vendor interface. If the site checks fail or reliable conversion is not viable, this optional fee does not apply.
Convert client-supplied tablet to an additional wall dashboard; about 1.5 hours.
Air-conditioning control moves into Home Assistant via AirTouch integration.
Tablet hardware is excluded from supplied-hardware warranty; configuration is covered by 60-day hyper-care. Defects in our work are not chargeable; out-of-scope work requires separate quote.

optionalAddons.title: Zeneva far-infrared sauna integration
details: Recommended 2-person Zeneva sauna is a supplier-confirmed Tuya Wi-Fi appliance.
Switch on and set temperature from wall displays and phones; one scene included.
The included sauna automation is additional to the six base automations.
Convenience auto-off when house is empty depends on Wi-Fi and presence detection and is not a safety device.

Temperature limits and overheat cutoff remain in the sauna; automations only switch on/off. Scheduled unattended preheating only after exact-model remote-start safeguards are checked against manufacturer instructions.
Subject to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi coverage. Fixed fee is best effort; if exact model cannot be integrated reliably, client is told before charge and fee does not apply.

Installation beyond the hours already delivered, and new electrical or cabling work, are quoted separately.
